key_points: Netflix CEO and Co-CEO warn growth is slower than desired, highlighting live programming challenges.
Analyst downgrades cite worrying engagement trends and rising YouTube pressure.
Stock has stalled since 2021 despite strong IPO-era returns, leading to valuation concerns.
Some commentary notes potential undervaluation and buy-upgrade scenarios, offering offsetting views.
No major earnings surprise or guidance change; news is mostly commentary and sentiment-driven.
